notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Added more sound effects[/b] [i](including laser sounds)[/i]
[*] [b]Added a tutorial panel animation[/b] [i](making it more obvious there is a tutorial when loading in)[/i]
[*] [b]Added ruin puzzle hints[/b] [i](some players were getting stuck trying to solve them)[/i]
[*] [b]Improved player movement animation[/b]
[*] [b]Added loading screen tips[/b]
[*] [b]Reworked teleporter triggers[/b] [i](they no longer teleport you back when staying still on them)[/i]
[*] [b]Removed biome sounds and effects while in ruins[/b]
[*] [b]Improved some upgrade icons[/b]
[*] [b]Added fireflies[/b]
[*] [b]Added some holiday cheer to the main menu[/b]
[*] [b]Added a limited-edition holiday accessory[/b]
[*] [b]Added some holiday cheer to dwellers[/b]
[*] [b]Other minor bug fixes[/b]
[/list]

[i]Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url][/i]

notes.title: Payloads!
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Added payloads[/b] [i](pushable blocks that can be deposited at dropoffs!  These occasionally spawn in place of an ore.)[/i]
[*] [b]Fixed minor audio issues[/b]
[*] [b]Other minor bug fixes[/b]
[*] [b]Lots of improvements to the steam page description[/b]
[/list]

[i]Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url][/i]

notes.title: Pushable Dropoffs!
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Added pushable dropoffs[/b] [i](they occasionally spawn in place of regular dropoffs, these new ones have less capacity, but can be moved!)[/i]
[*] [b]Added three new accessories[/b] [i](including an exclusive for those of you on the top of the leaderboard!)[/i]
[*] [b]Changed some visuals on the leaderboard[/b] [i](players on the top have more flare!)[/i]
[*] [b]Fixed respawning at teleporters[/b] [i](you no longer get stuck in a dying loop!)[/i]
[*] [b]Fixed accessories not saving[/b] [i](accessories now save when you equip them!)[/i]
[/list]

[i]Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092426/ed42f36a6edafd9d6ec7c4d8ace1c41e19835f74.png[/img]

notes.title: New Ruins and Puzzles!
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Added 35 new notes[/b] [i](a total of 75 notes now!)[/i]
[*] [b]Added two new ruins[/b] [i](Wooooo!)[/i]
[*] [b]Added pushable blocks for ruin puzzles[/b] [i](brand new mechanic, now implemented into the two new ruins!)[/i]
[*] [b]Increased ruin odds[/b] [i](ruins are now easier to find, this change applies to your current worlds as well, no need to make a new one!)[/i]
[*] [b]Added a new achievement[/b] [i](unlock by finding your first note!)[/i]
[/list]

[i]Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url][/i]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44092426/957ded13f9e829025287287a48e07b1b0f2747a8.png[/img]

notes.title: The STORY Update!
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]ADDITIONS / CHANGES[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]added XP loot boxes[/b] [i](can be found in ruins like the normal loot boxes)[/i]
[*] [b]added 40 notes that can spawn in ruins[/b] [i](lore! uncover the mysteries of the virus, and why this once flourishing cave has been abandoned, and consumed by a devastating virus)[/i]
[*] [b]added notes menu to the radial menu[/b] [i](here you can view your discovered notes, and read through them)[/i]
[/list]

Feel free to contact me in the [b]#voxel-miner[/b] channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  [url=https://discord.gg/bUJnbaXSVx]Discord Server[/url]
